name: Kroger Customer Fulfillment Center Forest Park GA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Chain-link perimeter fence with a sliding gate across the single entry driveway off the complex road (Kroger Dr) on the NW side; confirmed in Street View pano LisMFidlEnQ8ld0nKR9Yxg (2025-03, heading ~172 looking S).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth/shack structure visible at the gate in Street View or satellite z21; gate is unmanned.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Inferred: controlled gate but no guard booth implies kiosk/badge/app check-in. Medium confidence on the check-in mechanism.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved holding area inside the gate between employee parking and the dock wings provides queue/staging room before docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep paved approach from gate to docks holds well over 3 trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron and large open paved yard give physical room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ band: long dock banks with trailers backed in herringbone on multiple building wings (east wing both faces, south face). Exact count is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ band: dense trailer drop rows in the west, south and east/NE yards, many trailers parked without tractors.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage rows separate from active dock staging, west and NE of the building.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside metro Atlanta's dense industrial fabric (Gillem Logistics Center, former Fort Gillem), 9 mi south of downtown Atlanta.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: 1 building on this property (the cross/T-shaped CFC/fulfillment building). The separate 1.3M sq ft Kroger DC to the north is a distinct adjacent facility, not counted here.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into this property.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~19 acres for the active fenced footprint (building + paved yards), from the perimeter polygon.
